doc.name: Bolt Claw documentation agent
doc.description: Answers questions about Bolt Claw (social media scheduling and inbox, comment-to-DM automations, link-in-bio pages, referral programs, plans, the REST API, webhooks and the MCP server) with the Bolt Claw pages that answer them, best first. Read-only and no key: it cannot see or change an account.

skills.name: Answer questions about Bolt Claw
skills.description: Finds the Bolt Claw documentation and website pages that answer a question and returns them ranked, each with a markdown address to read next. Not for acting on an account: to schedule a post or read a workspace, connect the MCP server at https://mcp.boltclaw.ai/mcp, which asks the person to sign in. Claude: add https://mcp.boltclaw.ai/apps as a custom connector; ChatGPT: add https://mcp.boltclaw.ai/apps as an app in developer mode.
examples: How do I retry a Bolt Claw API request safely?
What does a 428 from the Bolt Claw API mean?
Which scope does creating a post need?
What does the Free plan include?
